findings.failure_scenario: If a developer updates `rust-toolchain.toml` to pin a dated nightly (which `read_pin` explicitly allows via `^nightly-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`), the `seed` step will successfully install it but then immediately fail the job during the proof step because the regex fails to match the real output of `rustc +nightly --version`.
findings.summary: The `assert_pinned_no_sync` proof fails when the pinned channel is a dated nightly because it checks if `rustc --version` starts with `rustc $ch ` (e.g. `rustc nightly-2026-01-02 `) but rustc actually outputs `rustc 1.X.X-nightly `.
